violations.why: ISR can run after the task writes v_onyx=0 but before the loop condition reads v_onyx, creating a write‑write‑read race.
ISR can preempt between the read of v_onyx for the loop condition and the write performed by v_onyx++ (the increment), yielding a read‑write‑write violation.
ISR can interrupt after the condition reads v_onyx; the task later reads v_onyx again in the next iteration, forming a read‑write‑read pattern.
